messages:
Josh: Quick sync — PM wants per-model/route SLO dashboards (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec) for next demo. We need a clear contract from runtime/infra on what signals and labels are reliable. Who owns the metric definitions?

Nina: I can take the runtime side. Current runtime emits: 
- runtime_latency_ms{model,route,region,variant} (histogram & summary)
- ttft_ms{model,route,variant} (gauge on first-token latency)
- tokens_generated_total{model,route,variant} (counter)
- tokens_inflight{pool,model} (gauge)
- batch_size{model,route} (histogram)
- cache_hit{model,route} (counter)

We need to agree on tags: model (model name), route (api route name), variant (quantized/float, fallback), region. No user_id in metrics.

Arjun: Thanks. Two asks from observability: (1) canonical metric names (snake_case), (2) cardinality limits — route+model+variant+region could explode. Propose we enforce a tagging whitelist and drop rare route labels. Also: sampling for histograms — are we sending full buckets or summary?

Nina: We currently emit histogram buckets for latency and batch_size. We can add aggregated precomputed P50/P95/P99 summaries in the runtime for high-cardinality combos to avoid ingestion bloat. That would be runtime-side computed percentiles exported as gauges: latency_p50_ms, latency_p95_ms, latency_p99_ms (with same labels).

Emily: From Console/product POV: default dashboard should show per-route cards and a model-rollup. Time windows: 5m/1h/24h. TTFT should be first-class (P50/P95), plus tokens/sec (derived metric: delta(tokens_generated_total)/delta(time)). We also want a Token throughput panel (tokens/sec) and a Serve Efficiency panel (tokens/sec per GPU or per-request).

Maya: Important: quotas and routing policies must be visible. If a route is hitting quota or fallback is triggered, dashboards need annotation overlays (e.g., shaded periods). How will runtime surface routing decisions? We need a route_event stream or gauge that indicates fallback_count{route,reason}.

Josh: Good point. We need an events signal for rollouts/fallbacks. Nina, can runtime emit fallback_count and route_version{route,version} as ephemeral events? Console can consume to annotate charts.

Nina: Yes, we have an event exporter (kafka -> telemetry). We can add: fallback_event_total{route,from_variant,to_variant,reason} and rollout_marker{route,version,deployed_by}. Those are counters/timestamps. Note: events go to an event topic, not Prometheus. Console needs to pull from event API.

Arjun: How do we tie event timestamps to metric time series for overlays? We should have a correlation_id in request traces (X-Req-ID) and include the route_version label on metrics emitted for that request. For rollouts, rollout_marker should include start_ts and end_ts in the event payload.

ConsoleUX: For dashboard UX, plan: 
- Top-level: model selector + route filter
- Time-series grid: P50/P95/P99 latency + TTFT + tokens/sec (stacked)
- Alerting: default SLOs: p95 latency < 500ms, ttft p95 < 200ms, tokens/sec baseline per model. Users can override per-customer.

Emily: Also need sampling guidance for traces. For high-traffic models we should sample traces for errors & cold-starts. This is separate but helpful to link to the dashboard via "investigate" button.

Maya: Regarding quotas, expose current_commit_usage{project,route} and quota_limit{project,route}. Console can compute percent usage and trigger soft alerts.

Josh: Action items: 
1) Nina: produce a canonical metric list (names + labels + cardinality guidance) and add runtime precomputed percentiles for common label combos.
2) Arjun: define ingest-side sampling/pipeline transforms and a labeling whitelist.
3) Emily/ConsoleUX: wire mock dashboards and list required event overlays and time windows.
4) Maya: enumerate quota metrics and routing event fields we need.
5) Everyone: agree on alert defaults for demo.

Nina: I'll drop a proto and a sample Prometheus exporter snippet by EOD. Example (will refine):
```
# metric names
latency_p50_ms{model="gpt-mini",route="chat",region="us-west-2",variant="q4_0"} 120
latency_p95_ms{model="gpt-mini",route="chat"} 450
ttft_p95_ms{model="gpt-mini",route="chat"} 180
tokens_generated_total{model="gpt-mini",route="chat"} 1234567
fallback_event_total{route="chat",from_variant="float32",to_variant="q4" ,reason="OOM"} 3
```

Arjun: Nice. For ingestion we'll map these to metric.schema v2. Key constraint: limit unique "route" values to <= 200 per org by default; special handling for ephemeral routes. Also will add a derived metric stream for tokens/sec to avoid client-side derivation.

Emily: For the demo, can we get a mock dashboard endpoint with sample panels by Thursday? If we have the metrics proto by EOD from Nina, Console team can fake data until pipeline is wired.

Maya: I'll draft the quota overlay spec and send it to this thread. Also +1 on fallback_event_total.

telemetry-bot: Reminder: please file a telemetry ticket with schema PR and link to the observability repo. Use template: TELEMETRY-NEW-METRIC.

Josh: Great. Let's reconvene Friday 10am PT to validate the proto and the mock dashboards. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
